               , '01.01.1900'                                as "Start Date"
               , '31.12.9999'                                as "End Date"
               , ''                                          as "Selective Service"                 -- Intentionally Left Blank
               , ''                                          as "Selective Service Reg. Compliance" -- Intentionally Left Blanm
               , case
                     when left(MILIT, 1) = '1' then 'VETR' -- Veteran
                     when left(MILIT, 1) = '2' then 'ACTD' -- Active Military Duty
                     when left(MILIT, 1) = '3' then 'RESV' -- Reserves
                     when left(MILIT,1) = '4' then 'VETR' -- Old Code 2010-2011. Veteran and Active Duty
                     when left(MILIT,1) = '5' then 'VETR' -- Old Code 2010-2011. Veteren and Reserves or National Guard
                     when left(MILIT,1) = '6' then 'ACTD' -- Old Code 2010-2011. Active Military Duty & Reserves or National Guard
                     when left(MILIT,1) = '7' then 'VETR' -- Old Code 2010-2011. Veteran & Active Military Duty & Reserves or National Guard
                     when left(MILIT, 1) = '8' then 'NATG' -- National Guard
                     when left(MILIT, 1) = '9' then 'ROTC' -- Reserve Officers Training Program (ROTC)
                     else null
                 end                                         as "Military Status"
               , case when upper(MILDEP) = 'Y' then 'Y' else 'N' end as "Military Dep. Status"

model.tss.v_related_persons_mc.raw_code:
/*
    - The address filter will only select CURRENT guardian addresses (address type in P1,P2), not historical addresses. This is critical because each address will create a new related persons record.

    Test Cases: 
    Example with 6 ECs and 2 PG Addresses w Phones: A17433429 / Key: 2177207
    Student with Email address but no address: A08970723    / Key: 1032716

    select * from slcm.V_RELATED_PERSONS_MC where ORIG_INTRL_REF_ID in (2177207,1032716)

*/

{{ config(materialized='view') }}

with SOURCE_DATA as
         (
            -- This represents the conversion of a parent adddress and related parent email address
            select
               cast(PID.PERSON_ID as char(10))                                               as "PID"
               , cast(GENERATED_ID as char(10))                                              as "Studentnumber"

               , coalesce(varchar_format(cast(ADDR.START_DATE as char(10)), 'MM.DD.YYYY'),varchar_format(cast(EMAIL.START_DATE as char(10)), 'MM.DD.YYYY')) as begda_rel -- This only based on the active addresses, not the EARLIEST PG address or email.
               , 'PA' as reltype -- TODO: Need Relcodes

               , null as firstname
               , 'Converted Parent/Guardian Info' as lastname
               , null as middlename
               , null as correspondlanguage
               , null as fullname
               , null as nationality
               , null as gender

               , null as c_o_name
               , trim(cast(ADDR.CITY_NAME as CHAR(40))) as city
               , trim(cast(ADDR.LINE_ADDRESS_1 as CHAR(60))) as street
               , trim(cast(ADDR.LINE_ADDRESS_2 as CHAR(40)))                          as "Street2"
               , trim(cast(ADDR.LINE_ADDRESS_3 as CHAR(40)))                          as "Street3"
               , trim(cast(ADDR.LINE_ADDRESS_4 as CHAR(40)))                          as "Street4"
               , trim(cast(ADDR.COUNTRY_CODE as CHAR(3))) as country
               , trim(cast(ADDR.STATE_CODE as CHAR(3))) as region


               , cast(case
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('CN','IN','HK','SG','VN','RU','MO','NG','EC','RO','CO','UZ','KZ') then '000000'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('AM','AT','DK','HU','LU','NZ','NO','PA','PH','ZA','CH','VE','SI','LB') then '0000'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('JP','CL') then '0000000'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('NP', 'SA') then '00000'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('SE','GR') then '000 00'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('CA') then 'A0A 0A0'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('GB') then 'A00 0AA'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('IE') then 'A00'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('BR') then '00000-000'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('JP') then '000-0000'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('PL') then '00-000'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('PT') then '0000-000'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and COUNTRY_CODE in ('AR') then 'A0000AAA'
                          when trim(coalesce(ADDR.ZIP_CODE, '')) = '' and addr.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID is not null then '00000'
                          else replace(trim(ADDR.ZIP_CODE), ' ', '-') end as CHAR(10)) as "PostalCode"               

               , null as languiso
               , varchar_format(cast(ADDR.START_DATE as char(10)), 'MM.DD.YYYY') as validfromdate
               , case when ADDR.END_DATE = '2999-12-31' then '31.12.9999' 
                else varchar_format(cast(ADDR.END_DATE as char(10)), 'MM.DD.YYYY') end as validtodate

               , EMAIL_ADDRESS_LINE as email
               , 'X' as stdemail
               , case
                        when EMAIL.EMAIL_ADDRESS_LINE is null then '01.01.0001'
                        else varchar_format(cast(EMAIL.START_DATE as char(10)), 'MM.DD.YYYY') end as validfrom
               , case
                        when EMAIL.EMAIL_ADDRESS_LINE is null then '31.12.9999'
                        else varchar_format(cast(EMAIL.END_DATE as char(10)), 'MM.DD.YYYY') end as validto

               , case when trim(coalesce(ADDR.TELEPHONE_ID,'')) <> '' then cast(ADDR.TELEPHONE_ID as CHAR(30))  else null end  phonenumber 
               , null as smsenabled
               , null as is_modile
               , case when trim(coalesce(ADDR.TELEPHONE_ID,'')) <> '' then 'X' else null end is_default
               , case when trim(coalesce(ADDR.TELEPHONE_ID,'')) <> '' then varchar_format(cast(ADDR.START_DATE as char(10)), 'MM.DD.YYYY')  else null end validfrom_ph
               , case when trim(coalesce(ADDR.TELEPHONE_ID,'')) <> '' then 
                    case when ADDR.END_DATE = '2999-12-31' then '31.12.9999'
                    else varchar_format(cast(ADDR.END_DATE as char(10)), 'MM.DD.YYYY') end 
                 else null end  validto_ph

               , 'Parent Address / Parent Email' as ORIG_TYPE
               , person.INTRL_REF_ID as ORIG_INTRL_REF_ID
               , addr.ADDRESS_TYPE_CODE as ORIG_ADDRESS_TYPE_CODE
               , email.EMAIL_ADDRESS_TYCD as ORIG_EMAIL_ADDRESS_TYCD

          from {{ ref('src_prs_person_mc') }} person
        left join  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_mc') }} pid
          on pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
              and pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9
        left join {{ ref ('src_pad_prs_address_mc') }} addr
            on addr.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
            and addr.ADDRESS_TYPE_CODE in ('P1','P2')
            and ADDR.END_DATE > current_date 
        left join {{ ref('src_ead_elect_addr_mc')}} email
            on person.INTRL_REF_ID  = email.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID
            and EMAIL_ADDRESS_TYCD in ('EMP1', 'EMP2')
            and EMAIL.END_DATE > current_date 
            -- Join when there is no address OR when there is an address and it's for the corresponding parent'
            and (addr.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID is null 
                or addr.ADDRESS_TYPE_CODE = case when EMAIL_ADDRESS_TYCD = 'EMP1' then 'P1' when EMAIL_ADDRESS_TYCD = 'EMP2' then 'P2' else 'Other' end
                )
        where email.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID is not null or addr.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID is not null
            



        union 
            -- This represents the conversion of a emergency contact phone numbers. 
            select
                cast(PID.PERSON_ID as char(10))                                               as "PID"
               , cast(GENERATED_ID as char(10))                                              as "Studentnumber"

               , varchar_format(cast(EMER.RCD_SET_TS as char(10)), 'MM.DD.YYYY') as begda_rel
               , EMER.RELATIONSHIP_CODE as reltype  -- TODO: These need to be coded by reltype: GU, OT, PA, SP 

               , 'Converted ISIS Emergency Contact' as firstname
               , EMER.CONTACT_NAME as lastname
               , null as middlename
               , null as correspondlanguage
               , null as fullname
               , null as nationality
               , null as gender

               , null as c_o_name
               , null as city
               , null as street
               , null as "Street2"
               , null as "Street3"
               , null as "Street4"
               , null as country
               , null as region
               , null as "PostalCode"               

               , null as languiso
               , null as validfromdate
               , null as validtodate

               , null as email
               , null as stdemail
               , null as validfrom
               , null as validto

               , EMER.TELEPHONE_ID as phonenumber 
               , null as smsenabled
               , null as is_modile
               , 'X' as is_default
               , varchar_format(cast(EMER.RCD_SET_TS as char(10)), 'MM.DD.YYYY') as validfrom_ph
               , '31.12.9999' as validto_ph

               , 'Emergency Contact' as ORIG_TYPE
               , person.INTRL_REF_ID as ORIG_INTRL_REF_ID
               , null as ORIG_ADDRESS_TYPE_CODE
               , null as ORIG_EMAIL_ADDRESS_TYCD

          from {{ ref('src_prs_person_mc') }} person
        left join  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_mc') }} pid
          on pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID

              and pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9
        inner join {{ ref ('src_ect_emer_contact_mc') }} emer
            on emer.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
        )

select *
from SOURCE_DATA

          on pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
              and pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9
          where coalesce(trim(person.SSN),'') <> ''

          union

          select
              cast (pid.PERSON_ID as char (10)) as "PID"
               , cast (pid.GENERATED_ID as char (10)) as "Studentnumber"
               , 'YITIN'  as "ID_Type"
               , trim(cast (id.PERSON_ID as char (60))) as "ID_No"

              and pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9

              length(id.person_id) = 9 
              and (left (id.person_id

              and (SUBSTR(id.person_id

              ) )
              and id.person_id <> person.ssn
              )
            )

    Logic:

{{ config(materialized='view') }}

with SOURCE_DATA as
         (
               select 'X'                                                                             as "DES Indicator"
               , cast(PID.PERSON_ID as char(10))                                           as "PID"
               , case when BIRTH_DATE = '0001-01-01' then '01.01.1900'
                    when BIRTH_DATE > CURRENT DATE then '01.01.1900' 
                    else varchar_format(cast(BIRTH_DATE as date), 'MM.DD.YYYY')  end as "Birthdate"
               -- , cast(GENDER_FLAG as char(1))                                                             as "Gender"
               , cast('EN' as char(2))                                                           as "Language"
               , case
                          when PERSON.DECEASED_DATE > CURRENT DATE then ''
                          else varchar_format(cast(PERSON.DECEASED_DATE as date), 'MM.DD.YYYY')    end                             as "DeathDate"
               , cast(null as date)                                                              as "DeathRecdate"                        -- intentionally left blank

               , cast('' as CHAR(1))                                                             as "VeriStat"                            -- intentionally left blank
               , cast(null as date)                                                              as "VeriDate"                            -- intentionally left blank
               , cast('' as CHAR(35))                                                            as "VeriName"                            -- intentionally left blank
               , cast('' as CHAR(12))                                                            as "BDUnknown"                           -- intentionally left blank
               -- , cast('LG' as CHAR(2))                                                           as "Subtype"
               , cast(PERSON_PRONOUN.LEGAL_FIRST_NAME as CHAR(40))                               as "Legal First Name"
               , cast(PERSON_PRONOUN.LEGAL_LAST_NAME as char(40))                                as "Legal Last Name"
               , cast(PERSON_PRONOUN.LEGAL_MIDDLE_NAME as CHAR(40))                              as "Legal Middle Name"

               , ''                                                                              as "Suffix"                              -- Intentonally left blank
                ,''                                                                                 as "Other Suffix"
               -- , cast('LV' as CHAR(2))                                                           as "Subtype2"
               , cast(PERSON_PREFERRED.FIRST_NAME as CHAR(40))                                   as "Lived First Name"
               , case
                     when PERSON_PREFERRED.FIRST_NAME is not null and PERSON_PREFERRED.LAST_NAME is null
                         then cast(PERSON_PRONOUN.LEGAL_LAST_NAME as char(40))
                     else cast(PERSON_PREFERRED.LAST_NAME as char(40)) end                       as "Lived Last Name"
               , case
                     when PERSON_PREFERRED.FIRST_NAME is not null and PERSON_PREFERRED.MIDDLE_NAME is null
                         then cast(PERSON_PRONOUN.LEGAL_MIDDLE_NAME as char(40))
                     else cast(PERSON_PREFERRED.MIDDLE_NAME as char(40)) end                     as "Lived Middle Name"

               , ''                                                                              as "Suffix2"                             -- Intentonally left blank
                ,''                                                                                 as "Other Suffix2"
               , ''                                                                              as "Use for Diploma"                     -- Intentonally left blank
               , ''                                                                              as "Use for Transcript"                  -- Intentonally left blank
               , ''                                                                              as "Use for Deans Congratulatory Letter" -- Intentonally left blank
               , ''                                                                              as "Name Not Present"                    -- Intentonally left blank
               , ''                                                                              as "Gender Identity"                     -- Intentonally left blank
               , ''                                                                              as "Other Gender Identity"               -- Intentonally left blank
               , ''                                                                              as "Sexual Orientation"                  -- Intentonally left blank
               , ''                                                                              as "Other Sexual Orientation"            -- Intentonally left blank
               , ''                                                                              as "Gender Expression ID"                -- Intentonally left blank
               , ''                                                                              as "Other Gender Expression"             -- Intentonally left blanks
               , trim(cast(case
                               when trim(PERSON_PRONOUN.PRONOUN) in
                                    ('He/Him', 'She/Her', 'They/Them', 'Ze/Hir', 'Per/Per', 'My Name', 'Other', '')
                                   then upper(PERSON_PRONOUN.PRONOUN)
                               else 'OTHER' end as char(9)))                                          as "Pronoun"
               , trim(cast(case
                               when trim(PERSON_PRONOUN.PRONOUN) not in
                                    ('He/Him', 'She/Her', 'They/Them', 'Ze/Hir', 'Per/Per', 'My Name', 'Other', '')
                                   then PERSON_PRONOUN.PRONOUN
                               else '' end as char(50)))                                         as "Other Pronoun"
               , GENDER_FLAG                                                                              as "Sex at Birth"                        -- Intentonally left blank
               ,PERSON_PREFERRED.FIRST_NAME as ORIG_PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME
               ,PERSON_PREFERRED.MIDDLE_NAME  as ORIG_PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME
               ,PERSON_PREFERRED.LAST_NAME as ORIG_PREFERRED_LAST_NAME
               ,PERSON_PRONOUN.PRONOUN as ORIG_PRONOUN
          from SLCM.SRC_PRS_PERSON_DES PERSON
                   left join {{ ref ('src_pid_person_id_des') }} PID
          on PID.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = PERSON.INTRL_REF_ID
              and PID.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9
              left join {{ ref ('src_systemex_person_des') }} des_person
              on des_person.PID = pid.PERSON_ID
              left join {{ ref ('src_systemex_v_person_name_pronoun_des') }} PERSON_PRONOUN
              on des_person.PERSONID = PERSON_PRONOUN.PERSON_ID
              left join {{ ref ('src_systemex_person_preferred_identifiers_des') }} PERSON_PREFERRED
              on des_person.PERSONID = PERSON_PREFERRED.PERSON_ID

          )

from SOURCE_DATA

/*

    - Grain is one row per application 

    select ORIG_INTRL_REF_ID, ORIG_APPLICATN_REF_NUM
    from slcm.V_ADMISSIONS_MC
    group by ORIG_INTRL_REF_ID, ORIG_APPLICATN_REF_NUM
    having count(*) > 1

    select *
    from slcm.V_ADMISSIONS_MC
    where ORIG_INTRL_REF_ID = 132115


*/

{{ config(materialized='view') }}

with SOURCE_DATA as
         (
select 
cast(PID.PERSON_ID as char(10))                                               as "PID"
, cast(GENERATED_ID as char(10))                                                as "Student Number"
-- , xwalk_sc.TSS_SC_SHORT as "Program of Study"
, varchar_format(cast(case when ADMIT_TERM_SEQ_ID<>0 then admit_term.START_DATE else application_term.START_DATE end as date), 'MM.DD.YYYY')  as "Valid From" -- TODO: Change to the calendar date from TSS.
, varchar_format(cast(case when ADMIT_TERM_SEQ_ID<>0 then admit_term.END_DATE else application_term.END_DATE end as date), 'MM.DD.YYYY')        as "Valid To" -- TODO: Change to the calendar date from TSS.

-- Here, I need to use the admit term if it exists. But if there IS no admit term, then I need to set this up as a rejected record. 
-- , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PID.PERSON_ID ORDER BY TERM.START_DATE ASC) AS "seqnr" 
, null as "seqnr" -- Intentionally Left Blank
,case when APPLICATN_DCSN_CD in ('TAG', 'WTL3', 'A01W', 'A03A', 'A01A', 'A03L', 'A01L', 'ADM', 'ALTA', 'AOA', 'AOR', 'AOS',
  'A01', 'A02', 'A03', 'A04', 'A05', 'A06', 'A07', 'A08', 'A09', 'A11', 'A12', 'A13', 'A14', 'A15', 'A16', 'A17', 'A18', 
  'ATAG', 'A19', 'COC', 'DUAD', 'EMPL', 'GADC', 'GADF', 'GAFF','GAMF', 'GAMP') then 1 -- Approved
    when APPLICATN_DCSN_CD in ('C40', 'C41', 'C46', 'A20', 'A21', 'A22', 'A23', 'CANC', 'C42', 'C43', 'C44', 'C45', 'DENY',
  'GADI', 'GD1', 'GD2', 'GD3', 'GD4', 'GD5', 'GD6', 'GD7', 'NRTN', 'RDIS', 'WDR', 'ZAP') then 5 -- Rejected/Withdrawn
    else 2 -- Created
 end as "Adm. Appl. Status" -- TODO: Expected values are 1-Approved, 2-Created, 3-Rejected/Withdrawn
, null as "admis_status_sup" -- Intentionally Left Blank
,'1' as "Program Choice"
, case when trim(admit_term.ACADEMIC_YEAR_CODE) = '' then admit_term.ACADEMIC_YEAR_CODE else application_term.ACADEMIC_YEAR_CODE end as "Academic Year"
, case when trim(app.ADMIT_TERM_CODE) <> '' then

        case when left(app.ADMIT_TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA' then '2'
        when left(app.ADMIT_TERM_CODE,2) = 'S1' then '6' 
        when left(app.ADMIT_TERM_CODE,2) = 'S2' then '7' 
        when left(app.ADMIT_TERM_CODE,2) = 'S3' then '5'  
        when left(app.ADMIT_TERM_CODE,2) = 'SP' then '4' 
        when left(app.ADMIT_TERM_CODE,2) = 'SU' then 'Unexpected Value' -- TODO: Confirm Mapping
        when left(app.ADMIT_TERM_CODE,2) = 'WI' then '3' 
        else 'Unexpected Value'
        end 
    else
      case when left(application_term.TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA' then '2'
        when left(application_term.TERM_CODE,2) = 'S1' then '6'

macro.dbt_ibmdb2.ibmdb2__get_catalog.name: ibmdb2__get_catalog
macro.dbt_ibmdb2.ibmdb2__get_catalog.macro_sql:
{% macro ibmdb2__get_catalog(information_schema, schemas) -%}

  {%- call statement('catalog', fetch_result=True) -%}

    WITH columns AS (
      SELECT
        COLNAME,
        TYPENAME,
        CURRENT_SERVER AS DATABASE, -- Should be replaced by DB from profile
        TABNAME,
        TABSCHEMA,
        COLNO
      FROM SYSCAT.COLUMNS
    ),
    tables AS (
      SELECT
        CURRENT_SERVER AS DATABASE, -- Should be replaced by DB  from profile
        TABSCHEMA,
        TABNAME,
        OWNER,
        CASE
          WHEN TYPE = 'T' THEN 'TABLE' -- Upcase here to work with tests
          WHEN TYPE = 'V' THEN 'VIEW'  -- Upcase here to work with tests
        END AS TYPE
      FROM SYSCAT.TABLES
      WHERE TYPE IN('T', 'V')
    )
    SELECT
      TRIM(tables.DATABASE) AS "table_database",
      TRIM(tables.TABSCHEMA) AS "table_schema",
      TRIM(tables.TABNAME) AS "table_name",
      tables.TYPE AS "table_type",
      NULL AS "table_comment",
      TRIM(columns.COLNAME) AS "column_name",
      columns.COLNO AS "column_index",
      columns.TYPENAME AS "column_type",
      NULL AS "column_comment",
      tables.OWNER AS "table_owner"
    FROM tables
    INNER JOIN columns ON
      columns.DATABASE = tables.DATABASE AND
      columns.TABSCHEMA = tables.TABSCHEMA AND
      columns.TABNAME = tables.TABNAME
    WHERE (
        {%- for schema in schemas -%}
          tables.TABSCHEMA = UPPER('{{ schema }}') {%- if not loop.last %} OR {% endif -%}
        {%- endfor -%}
    )
    ORDER BY
      tables.TABSCHEMA,
      tables.TABNAME,
      columns.COLNO

  {%- endcall -%}
  {{ return(load_result('catalog').table) }}
{%- endmacro %}

macro.dbt.default__snapshot_merge_sql.macro_sql:
{% macro default__snapshot_merge_sql(target, source, insert_cols) -%}
    {%- set insert_cols_csv = insert_cols | join(', ') -%}

    merge into {{ target }} as DBT_INTERNAL_DEST
    using {{ source }} as DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE
    on DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_scd_id = DBT_INTERNAL_DEST.dbt_scd_id

    when matched
     and DBT_INTERNAL_DEST.dbt_valid_to is null
     and DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_change_type in ('update', 'delete')
        then update
        set dbt_valid_to = DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_valid_to

    when not matched
     and DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_change_type = 'insert'
        then insert ({{ insert_cols_csv }})
        values ({{ insert_cols_csv }})

{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt.default__snapshot_staging_tabl.macro_sql:
{% macro default__snapshot_staging_table(strategy, source_sql, target_relation) -%}

    with snapshot_query as (

        {{ source_sql }}

    ),

    snapshotted_data as (

        select *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key

        from {{ target_relation }}
        where dbt_valid_to is null

    ),

    insertions_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_updated_at,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_valid_from,
            nullif({{ strategy.updated_at }}, {{ strategy.updated_at }}) as dbt_valid_to,
            {{ strategy.scd_id }} as dbt_scd_id

        from snapshot_query
    ),

    updates_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_updated_at,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_valid_from,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_valid_to

        from snapshot_query
    ),

    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes %}

    deletes_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key
        from snapshot_query
    ),
    {% endif %}

    insertions as (

        select
            'insert' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*

        from insertions_source_data as source_data
        left outer join snapshotted_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key is null
           or (
                snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key is not null
            and (
                {{ strategy.row_changed }}
            )
        )

    ),

    updates as (

        select
            'update' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*,
            snapshotted_data.dbt_scd_id

        from updates_source_data as source_data
        join snapshotted_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where (
            {{ strategy.row_changed }}
        )
    )

    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes -%}
    ,

    deletes as (

        select
            'delete' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_valid_from,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_updated_at,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_valid_to,
            snapshotted_data.dbt_scd_id

        from snapshotted_data
        left join deletes_source_data as source_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where source_data.dbt_unique_key is null
    )
    {%- endif %}

    select * from insertions
    union all
    select * from updates
    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes %}
    union all
    select * from deletes
    {%- endif %}

{%- endmacro %}

doc.dbt.__overview__.block_contents:
### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.

---

### More information

- [What is dbt](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/introduction)?
- Read the [dbt viewpoint](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/viewpoint)
- [Installation](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/installation)
- Join the [dbt Community](https://www.getdbt.com/community/) for questions and discussion

doc.tss.__overview__.block_contents:
# TSS Project

This document will help you view the data rules and lineage at a *very technical* level. It includes full SQL for the views that generate conversion files. 

You'll primarily want to view *tss* on the *Projects* tab on the left. This will provide the SQL used to generate data for TSS:
- src_ ... indicates a raw view that is usually an unchanged table, but may ocassionaly contain a filter.
- int_ ... indicates a view that performs an intermediate transformation, such as pivoting a table.
- v_ ... indicates a view that is used to export data for TSS
- x_ ... indicates a view or table that is used as a reference for the conversion

# Database Tab

The Database tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are not shown in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

# Graph Exploration

You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the Expand button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build, or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the --select and --exclude model selection syntax to filter the models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the dbt docs.

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
